text:
About 0.5 ha of native forest was lost in 2022, according to the evidence.

- Hansen/UMD mapped about 0.6 ha of tree-cover loss in 2022, or 3.4% of the 17.6 ha property.
- The 2021 MGAP forest map classes about 0.5 ha of that loss as native forest and 0.1 ha as outside mapped forest. None of it is planted forest.
- The JRC 2020 forest reference agrees with the loss area, and later years through 2025 were observed, so the loss is corroborated.
- Hansen also shows a further 0.2 ha of loss in patches under 0.5 ha in 2022. These were not counted as an event, so they are not part of the 0.5 ha figure.

This shows tree-cover loss, not necessarily deforestation or a land-use change. It does not establish the cause, whether the change was legal, who was responsible, or any compliance status.
